_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
A nye Player {player_id} kɩnɛ kpɛlɛkɩm {num_players}-kpɛlɛkɩm Liar's Dice tʋm.
Sɔsɔɔlɩ:
- A tʋm taa, a pɩzɩɣ a nɛɛ:
  1) Kpaɣɖɛ kɔɔ mbʋʋ kɩ-taa tɔm kɔɔ pɩ-taa nɛɛ kɩ-taa yɔɔ (ɛzɩ pɩ-taa nɛɛ kɩ-taa tɔm) pɩ-taa nɛɛ kɩ-taa yɔɔ '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Yɛɛ kpaɣɖɛ kɔɔ tɔm kɔɔ pɩ-taa nɛɛ '[Call]'.

A yɛɛ kpaɣɖɛ kɔɔ:
  - A tɔm kɔɔ pɩ-taa nɛɛ tɔm kɔɔ ɛ-taa nɛɛ kɩ-taa tɔm kɔɔ pɩ-taa nɛɛ, kpaɣɖɛ kɔɔ tɔm kɔɔ lɩzɩɣ kɔɔ kʋɖʋm.
  - A tɔm kɔɔ pɩ-taa nɛɛ tɔm kɔɔ ɛ-taa nɛɛ kɩ-taa tɔm kɔɔ pɩ-taa nɛɛ, yɛɛ kpaɣɖɛ kɔɔ lɩzɩɣ kɔɔ kʋɖʋm.
Kpɛlɛkɩm weyi ɛfɛyɩ kʋɖʋm ɛ-taa nɛɛ ɛ-ɛlɩɣ. Kpɛlɛkɩm weyi ɛkɩlɩ ɛ-taa nɛɛ ɛ-ɛwɛʋ.

board.new_round:
New round - Remaining dice: {dice_summary}
Ɛyʊ ɛyɔɔdʊ tɔm hʊyʊ: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Piloto {current_player_id} calls! Actual count of face {face_value} èyɛ {count}, ɛlɛɛyɛ LESS than {quantity}.
Piloto {loser_id} (the last bidder) loses one die.
call.caller_loses:
Piloto {current_player_id} calls! Actual count of face {face_value} èyɛ {count}, ɛlɛɛyɛ >= {quantity}.
Piloto {loser_id} (the caller) loses one die.

invalid_move.not_recognized: Pɔɖɛɛ pʋʋ ŋɖɛɛ wiɖe kɩsɩ kɛ '[Bid: X, Y]' yaa '[Call]'. Pɔɖɛɛ ŋɖɛɛ tɔm: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: New quantity {new_quantity} èyɛ ɖɩkpaɣna naɣyɩ taa current {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: New face value {new_face_value} èyɛ ɖɩkpaɣna naɣyɩ taa current {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.face_range: Pɩwɛɛ se kɩ-tɛ ñɩm ɛwɛɛ 1 nɛ 6 pɛ-hɛkʋ taa.

message.eliminated_invalid: Piloto {player_id} ɛɛlɩmɩna pɩlɩɣna ɛyɔɔdʊ tɔm hʊyʊ.
